message: Demo video done: /labs/video/cauce-labs.mp4 (2:10, 1920x1080, 30 fps, H.264 High, faststart, no audio, 52.3 MB) + vertical cut cauce-labs-vertical.mp4 (34.8 s, 1080x1920, phone layouts captured natively) + poster.jpg + chapters page index.html (#t= links, links to all 12 prototypes) + README.
